name: Monochrome Blues
source:
To get back into the groove after a traumatic loss, 
Maja starts a new job as a preschool teacher.
And somewhere among these children
lies the key to a strange future
that's much closer than she thinks...

[from [url=https://lizmical.itch.io/monoblues]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
為了走出失去所愛的創傷，瑪雅開始擔任幼兒園教師。
在這些孩子之中，
隱藏著通往奇怪未來的鑰匙，
而那個未來比她想像的更近……

[來源：[url=https://lizmical.itch.io/monoblues]itch.io[/url]]
